name: 未対応列が残るCSV取込の検証・続行フッター
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied HubSpot CSV import footer as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 1920x112 pixels (17.14:1), an ultra-wide footer row. Preserve its left and right grouping and broad empty center. Do not add the mapping table, modal title, watermark, or other dialog content.

At the far left, show an outlined white button with a thin coral border, a small left chevron, and 「戻る」 in coral. Immediately to its right, show plain dark text 「キャンセル」. Keep these controls vertically centered in the footer.

At the right, align a bold dark notice above the checkbox: 「未対応の列が2つあります」. Directly below, show one small empty square checkbox with 「未対応の列のデータをインポートしない」 in dark gray. At the far right, show a pale gray disabled button with 「次へ」 and a small right chevron. Preserve the checkbox unchecked and the Next action disabled.

Use compact HubSpot-style sans-serif text, thin neutral borders, the source's coral Back treatment, dark warning copy, pale disabled Next button, exact control sizes, alignment, and huge horizontal span. Keep all text on one line and preserve the 1920x112 aspect ratio without blank bands. Use the crop as the authority for layout, state, and spacing.
reviewNotes: v001 includes Back, Cancel, the two-unmapped-columns warning, unchecked exclusion checkbox, and disabled Next. The 2172x724 canvas embeds the 1920x112 footer with large blank bands, breaking the source 17.14:1 composition. Earlier wide-strip generation and reframe attempts repeated the same canvas constraint; recorded needs-correction after one attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
